{"question": "Why must the dashboard never use localStorage?"}

The dashboard never uses localStorage because it stores API keys and other credentials in JavaScript, which is a security risk. Instead, it uses server-side sessions and a cookie that is marked as `HttpOnly`, so it can't be read by JavaScript. This is implemented in increments 6 and above. [docs/DASHBOARD.md]
